kennel_club_uk.notes: head fairly large; skull broad and square, high from jaw corner to skull top; face short; muzzle short, broad, deep, slightly upturned; defined stop with a furrow to mid-skull; lower jaw projects slightly; flews thick, broad and deep; eyes round, low and wide; small thin rose ears set high; slight dewlap each side of the neck; chest wide, deep; loin higher than shoulders; forelegs short, wide-set, straight; hind legs slightly longer; tail short, thick at root, tapering, set low, carried down; coat short, close, smooth, fine; head skin finely wrinkled, over-nose wrinkle must not hide eyes or nose
kennel_club_uk.source: https://www.kusa.co.za/images/breed%20stds%20djaki/Bulldog%20-%20KC%20[01-2026].pdf (KC standard, facts extracted, text not copied)

withers_mm.why: middle of the usual 355-400 mm range; the plush is scaled by nose to tail base anyway

elbow_over_height.why: short forelegs, deep brisket; read from the reference side view, firm up with photos
